caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a teapot. The teapot is rendered in shades of reddish-brown, with shadows and highlights giving it a three-dimensional appearance. The body of the teapot is rounded with a slightly flattened base, and it features an elongated, curved spout on the left side of the image. The handle is on the right side, arching upward and outward in a gentle curve. The teapot has a domed lid with a finial knob on top that is shaded in black and gray. The light source appears to come from the upper left, as indicated by the highlights and the shadow cast on the lower left side. The background is plain and cream-colored, with slight discoloration and faint lines visible. There is a signature in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Tea Kettle
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
